transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Name]. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi, Doctor. It's really nice to meet you. Um, thank you for seeing me. I... well, I hope I'm giving you the right information, I just want to make sure I'm doing this right. 

I guess what really scared me enough to actually come in today is... well, it's a little embarrassing to admit, to be honest. I've been, um, hearing my name called. Just my name, nothing bad or anything! But I'll hear it coming from the hallway at home, and... and it happened once at the warehouse where I work, too, when absolutely nobody was around. 

It's just strange because it sounds as real as my husband standing right next to me. I know that probably sounds a little crazy, I'm sorry. Is that the kind of thing I should be telling you?
Can you tell me if you’ve heard any other sounds, voices, or noises besides your name being called?

Um, no, doctor. No, I haven't. It's really just my name, nothing else. I haven't heard any... you know, conversations or whispers or anything scary like that. I promise I would tell you if I did, I really want to be completely honest with you so we can figure this out. 

It's just that one thing. I hope that's an okay answer? I mean, I guess it's a good thing it's just my name and nothing worse, right? I just want to make sure I'm giving you what you need to know. Am I doing okay so far?
Have you noticed any other unusual sensations, like things feeling unreal, or maybe things looking or sounding different than they normally would?

No, I... I don't think so. Everything else seems pretty normal to me. Things look the way they always do, and... and nothing feels unreal or anything like that. 

I mean, I get a little tired sometimes, but who doesn't, right? But as far as things looking or sounding weird, other than the name thing... no. I haven't noticed anything like that. 

Is it okay that I don't have anything else to tell you about that? I'm not leaving anything out on purpose, I promise. I just want to make sure I'm answering your questions the right way.

Have you ever had any thoughts or beliefs that others might find unusual or hard to understand, like thinking something is happening that isn't, or believing something strongly that others don't agree with?

Um, no, doctor. I... I really don't think so. I'm just a regular person, you know? I don't have any strange ideas or... or believe things that aren't true. 

I mean, I get along with everyone at the warehouse, and my husband and I see eye-to-eye on pretty much everything. I definitely don't have any weird beliefs that would make people uncomfortable. I'm sorry if I'm not giving you much to go on with that question. I just want to be a good patient and give you the right answers, but I really don't have anything like that happening. Is it alright that my answer is no? I hope I'm not making your job harder.
Have you ever felt like something was happening around you that others didn’t seem to notice, even if you didn’t talk about it?

Oh, um... no. No, I haven't. I mean, at the warehouse, we all pretty much see and do the same things, you know? I don't ever feel like there's some secret thing going on that only I can tell is happening. I'm just... I'm just a normal team player, really. 

I feel a little bad that I keep saying no to all these questions, though. I really hope I'm being helpful to you. Is it alright that I don't have anything like that to report? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information so we can get everything sorted out. Am I doing okay?
Have you ever had a belief that something was true, even when others told you it wasn’t, or when there was no proof to support it?

No, I... I really don't think I've ever had anything like that happen. I try to be pretty level-headed, you know? If my husband or the folks at work tell me I've got something wrong, I usually just listen to them. I don't like to argue or make a fuss. 

I really try to see things the way everyone else does. I don't want to be difficult or... or have people think I'm stubborn about things that aren't true. 

I'm sorry, I feel like I'm just giving you a bunch of "no"s today. I really am trying to answer everything as honestly as I can. Is it okay that I don't have any examples of that? I hope I'm still giving you what you need.
Have you ever had a strong feeling or belief about something that you know is probably not true, even if you’ve never told anyone about it?

Um, no, doctor. I don't... I don't think I've ever felt that way. I mean, I really try to just focus on what's real and what's in front of me, especially with work and taking care of things at home. I wouldn't want to get caught up in... in things that aren't true, you know? 

I really try to keep my feet on the ground. I wouldn't want anyone to think I was... well, that I wasn't thinking straight. 

I'm so sorry, I feel terrible that I keep giving you the same answer. I just want to make sure I'm doing this right. I'm not messing up your evaluation by not having these things happen, am I? I just want to be a good patient for you.
Have you ever had a belief that something was true, even when there was no proof to support it or when others showed you that it wasn’t true?

Um... no, I haven't. I mean, I think this is sort of like what you were asking just a minute ago, right? About believing things that aren't true? I still... I really just don't have anything like that. 

I try really hard to just be agreeable and go with the flow. If my husband or my boss says something is a certain way, I just trust them. It's easier that way, and it keeps everyone happy. I wouldn't want to be the kind of person who insists on something when everyone else says it's wrong. 

I'm really, really sorry that I don't have a better answer for you. I feel like a broken record, just sitting here saying no over and over. Are you sure I'm not ruining your notes? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the kind of answers you need to do your job. Am I still being helpful?
Have you ever believed something strongly that others might not agree with, even if you didn’t talk about it or act on it?

I... well, I know we keep circling back to this, and I really wish I could give you a different answer so you could check off whatever box you need. But honestly, no. I just don't have those kinds of thoughts. 

I'm just a normal person, you know? I go to work, I stock the shelves, I come home, I make dinner. I don't have time to sit around thinking up strange things that aren't true. I just try to be a good wife and a good worker. 

I feel awful that I'm not giving you what you're looking for. You're being so patient with me, asking it in all these different ways, and I just keep letting you down. Is it... is it a problem that I don't have these beliefs? I mean, I'm trying to be as helpful as I can, I promise.

Have you ever had any concerns or beliefs about something happening to you that you couldn’t shake, even if it seemed unlikely—like someone watching you, trying to harm you, or having a serious illness, for example?

Oh, goodness, no. Definitely not. Nobody is watching me or trying to hurt me, and I've been perfectly healthy, thank goodness. I mean, I don't think anyone would want to watch me anyway, I'm just stocking shelves all day! 

I really... I know you have to ask all these specific things, and I appreciate how thorough you're being with me. You're doing such a wonderful job. I just feel so guilty that I keep shooting down every single one of your questions. I promise I'm not trying to be difficult or hide anything from you. It's just a very quiet, normal life I lead. 

Is it... is it okay that my answers are so boring? I really hope I'm not making your job harder today by not having any of these things to talk about. I'm doing okay, right?
Have you ever had a belief that was very important to you, even if you never told anyone about it and others might not have agreed with it?

I... um... no, I really haven't. I mean, I don't have any secret beliefs or anything like that. I just... I really don't. 

I know we've spent so much time on this, and I feel just terrible that I keep giving you the exact same answer. You must think I'm being stubborn, but I'm really, really not. I just want to give you the right information so you can do your assessment. 

I don't have anything hidden away that I'm keeping from you, I promise. I just try to be a good person and do what's expected of me. I really hope that's alright... I'm still doing okay, aren't I? I just want to make sure I'm giving you what you need.
Have you ever had a personal experience or thought that you felt deeply was true, even if you couldn't explain why or others might not see it the same way?

I... oh dear, I feel like a broken record. I really don't. I don't have any deep thoughts like that. I just... I really don't think about much besides what aisle I need to restock or what I'm making for supper. 

I'm so sorry, doctor. I know you're just doing your job, and you're being so kind to keep trying to find a way to ask me this so I understand. I just feel so foolish that I can't give you a better answer. I really am trying to be cooperative, I swear it. I just don't want you to think I'm holding back on you. 

I hope you're not getting frustrated with me. Am I... am I being too difficult? I really want to make sure I'm doing this right for you.
Have you ever believed something strongly that turned out not to be true, even if you never talked about it or acted on it?

Well... I suppose... I mean, there was one time, but it's really nothing to worry about. It's just a silly thing, really. 

I was doing my crafts, you know, just making things at home, and... well, I got it in my head that I could turn it into a real retirement business. Like, right away. I just felt so sure that everyone would see I had figured out the perfect plan for our family, to take care of us. I thought it was going to be this huge success and I wouldn't have to stock shelves anymore. 

Of course, it didn't really pan out that way, and I realize now it was a bit... ambitious. I feel a little embarrassed even bringing it up, to be honest. It's just a silly daydream that got a bit out of hand, I suppose. 

Does that... does that answer your question better? I hope that's the kind of thing you were looking for. I really do want to be helpful.
When you heard your name being called, did you have any particular idea about why it was happening or who might have been saying it, even if it didn’t make complete sense?

Oh, um... well... I really didn't know who it was, or why. And I... I feel a bit foolish even admitting this, because I really don't want you to think badly of me, or think I'm making things up. But... well, to be completely honest, it's actually what scared me enough to finally come in and see you. 

I just... I would be at home, and I'd hear my name being called right from the hallway. And then it happened once at the warehouse, too, when absolutely nobody was in that section with me. I looked all over, but no one was there. But it sounded so clear... just exactly as real as if my husband was standing right next to me speaking to me. 

I didn't have any grand idea about why it was happening, and I just kept trying to ignore it so I wouldn't be a bother to my family. I'm so sorry, doctor, I know that probably sounds terribly strange. I hope you don't think I'm losing my mind... is it alright that I told you that? I just want to make sure I'm answering your questions the right way.
Have you ever thought there might be a special reason or meaning behind hearing your name, even if you didn’t talk about it or weren’t completely sure?

Oh, no, I... I really haven't. I promise I'm not hiding anything from you, I just... I never thought there was a special meaning to it. 

I just thought maybe I was tired, you know? Working the shifts I do, and then trying to keep the house nice... I just figured my mind was playing tricks on me because I needed a good night's sleep. I never thought it was some kind of message or anything grand like that. I'm just a normal person, really. 

I hope it's okay that I don't have a better answer for you. I feel like I'm letting you down when you ask these questions and I just have to keep saying no. Am I being helpful at all? I really want to make sure I'm giving you what you need to figure this out.
Have you ever been absolutely sure something was true, even though there was no real proof, and it turned out not to be true at all?

Um... no, I really don't think so. I mean, aside from that little daydream about the craft business I told you about earlier, I don't think I've ever been absolutely sure of something that wasn't true. 

I try to stay pretty grounded, you know? Just focusing on my shifts and making sure everything is taken care of at home. I don't really get caught up in things without proof. 

I feel awful, I feel like I just keep saying no to your questions. I promise I'm not trying to be difficult or hold anything back from you. I'm really trying my best to think of something. Is it alright that I don't have another example for you? I just want to make sure I'm doing this right and being a good patient for you.
Have you ever had a belief that was so strong it felt completely true to you, even when there was no real evidence or proof to support it?

Oh, um... I think that's pretty much the same as what you just asked, right? Or maybe I misunderstood? I'm sorry if I'm making you repeat yourself, I really don't mean to be frustrating. 

But no, I... I really can't think of anything like that. Like I said, I'm just a regular person, just going to work and taking care of my family. I don't really get these strong beliefs out of nowhere. I hope that's an okay answer... I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information. Am I doing okay?
Have you ever believed something so strongly that you knew in your heart it was true, even when there was no real proof or others tried to tell you otherwise?

Oh, goodness... I feel terrible, I really do. I feel like I must be doing something wrong because you keep having to ask me this, and I just keep giving you the same answer. I'm so sorry if I'm ruining your assessment. 

I promise I'm really racking my brain for you, but... no. I'm really not the type to dig my heels in like that. If my husband or my supervisor at the warehouse tells me I've got something wrong, I usually just assume they're right and I made a mistake. I don't really argue or hold onto things if people tell me otherwise. 

I really hope you're not upset with me. I just want to be completely honest with you and not make anything up. Is there... is there something specific I should be looking for? I can try harder to think of something if you need me to.
Have you ever believed something very strongly that was later proven to be completely false, even if it didn't seem important to others at the time?

Oh, dear... I'm so, so sorry. I feel like a broken record, and I know I must be testing your patience by now. I really am trying to understand what you're looking for, I promise I am. 

But... no, I really haven't. I just... I don't really have those kinds of intense beliefs about things. I'm just a pretty simple person. I go to my shifts, I come home, I try to keep the house tidy. I don't really have the time or energy to get caught up in things that aren't real. 

I'm so sorry I keep letting you down with my answers. I feel like I'm failing this interview somehow. Are you sure I'm not wasting your time? I really want to be helpful... I just don't have anything like that to tell you. I hope you can forgive me for not being a better help with this part.
Have you ever had a belief that something was real or true, even though there was no proof and others might not have agreed with you, even if you never talked about it or acted on it?

Oh, wow... I... I really feel like I'm doing a terrible job here. You keep trying to ask this in different ways, and I just... I keep giving you nothing. I'm so sorry. I must seem so uncooperative, but I swear I'm not trying to be difficult. 

I've been sitting here trying to think of any little thing, even if I kept it to myself... but honestly, no. I just don't have those kinds of thoughts. I'm just a normal, boring person, you know? I go to work, stock the shelves, come home to my family. I don't really have any secret beliefs or anything like that. 

I really hope I'm not making you frustrated. I just want to give you the right answers so you can do your job. Am I... am I doing okay? I can keep trying to think if you want me to. I just feel so bad that I keep saying no.
